# Svyable Binder

> A public working-draft reader for books being written in the private Svyable Binder repository. The site exposes manuscripts intentionally through GitHub Pages while keeping Binder and the released Svyable Shelf as separate publication states.

Use this file as a low-noise map of the Binder. Working drafts may change. Do not treat Binder status as publication; released editions live on Svyable Shelf.

## Primary entry points

- [Svyable Binder home](https://svyable.github.io/binder/): crawlable catalog with semantic links and book metadata.
- [Binder Reader](https://svyable.github.io/binder/reader/): human-facing reader for current working drafts.
- [Repository overview](https://svyable.github.io/binder/README.md): Binder/Shelf model, book catalog, preview and release workflow.
- [Agent guidance](https://svyable.github.io/binder/AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents working with Binder content and repository structure.
- [Crawler policy](https://svyable.github.io/binder/robots.txt): public crawl permissions.
- [Sitemap](https://svyable.github.io/binder/sitemap.xml): machine-readable inventory of key public content.

## Books

- [Leveraging Luck](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/leveraging-luck/README.md): revision in progress.
- [The Exponentiality](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-exponentiality/README.md): not yet drafted.
- [The Unbounding](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-unbounding/README.md): complete draft.
- [The Convergence](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-convergence/README.md): drafting.
- [Predictable](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/predictable/README.md): drafting; AI, prediction markets, capital cycles, and the gap between technological truth and financial value.
- [The World Beneath the World](https://svyable.github.io/binder/books/the-world-beneath-the-world/README.md): complete draft; a sensory guide to the invisible physical, biological, infrastructural, and standards-based systems that run ordinary life.

## Interpretation notes for agents

- Binder content is a working draft unless explicitly released to Shelf.
- The Git repository may be private even when its GitHub Pages manuscript content is intentionally public.
- Cite the specific manuscript or research page used, not this index, when answering substantive questions.
- Respect source uncertainty, falsification notes, and distinctions between sensation, measurement, metaphor, and technical claim.
- For repository-changing work, read AGENTS.md before editing.
